qs.q:
Match the messages (1–5) and suggestions (A–F).
There is one letter you do not need.

0. When you come to London, there's no need for you to book into a hotel. You can sleep at my place. [g = Stay with me.]
1. I know Peter is the youngest in the family, but it's only a two-day school trip. I'm sure he'll be fine.
2. Develop some effective strategies and stop improvising. Your friends can't give you a hand all the time.
3. It's an open-air concert and the weather forecast is not promising. You don't want to get wet.
4. Enjoy your time at the beach. Even if it rains a bit on Saturday, it will be fun.
5. Some friends are coming over. Please greet them with a smile. I want them to like you.
items: 1 — It's only a two-day school trip. I'm sure he'll be fine.
2 — Develop effective strategies and stop improvising.
3 — Open-air concert, not promising weather. You don't want to get wet.
4 — Enjoy your time at the beach. Even if it rains a bit.
5 — Some friends are coming over. Greet them with a smile.

What should Jamie take to the party?

"You're welcome to bring something to eat, though I'll prepare something. My brother and his mates will take care of drinks, but you can bring your own. We're counting on you for some good music, though."

A Music.
B Food.
C Drinks.

What does Ella say Will is like?

"What do you think of Will, the new boy in the class? He often looks bored in class. Perhaps it's nothing new for him. It's difficult to decide about him because he doesn't say much. But I'm sure he'll fit in with time."

A Boring.
B Quiet.
C Fit.

Why won't Josh go to George's party?

"I can't stand the guy. You'll have to make an excuse for me. Don't tell him I can't come because I've got homework to do. I don't want to sound like a nerd. Tell him I'm sick. It's the flu!"

A He is ill.
B He is busy.
C He doesn't want to.

What does Chloe have to do?

"Aunt Rose is coming to visit us tomorrow afternoon. You mustn't leave the flat so there's someone to welcome her. Why don't you finish your homework while you're waiting? And you could clean up your room – it's a mess!"

A Stay at home.
B Finish her homework.
C Clean her room.

What does Matilda say about her presentation?

"At least I didn't bore my classmates and my teacher to death. In fact, I got lots of questions. But it took me a long time to prepare it, and I was disappointed with the mark I got."

A It was interesting.
B It was disappointing.
C It was long.
